entities.name: Sardia
entities.description: A mountain nation of dwarves in the Sardian Mountains during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Traded with the dwarves of Sardia for his war effort and later betrayed them.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: The other Brother, who also traded with the dwarves.

entities.name: Colossus of Sardia
entities.description: Created by Urza with Sardian resources, used in the final battle on Argoth.

entities.name: Sardian minotaurs
entities.description: Neighbors of the dwarves called upon for aid.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation the Sardian dwarves rose against.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Site of the war's final battle.

events.summary: Urza trades with the Sardian dwarves and uses their resources to create the Colossus of Sardia.
events.quote: Urza used the dwarves' resources to create the Colossus of Sardia

events.summary: Urza finds the dwarves trading with Mishra too; they rise against Argive and are slaughtered.
events.quote: Urza found out that the dwarves of Sardia were trading with Mishra too

events.summary: Urza betrays the Sardian dwarves, who call on the Sardian minotaurs for aid.
events.quote: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves

relations.note: Traded resources to fuel his war effort
relations.quote: so Urza traded with the dwarves to fuel his war effort
